commit.message:
Refresh contributor workflows and project metadata (#79)

Merge the audited contributor documentation, metadata, and repository templates. Includes co-author credit for the notebook typo previously proposed in #75. No runtime, model, or release artifacts are changed.

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+name: Bug report
+description: Report a reproducible problem with Vocos
+title: "[Bug]: "
+labels: [bug]
+body:
+  - type: markdown
+    attributes:
+      value: |
+        Thanks for helping improve Vocos. Please search existing issues before filing a new report.
+  - type: textarea
+    id: summary
+    attributes:
+      label: Problem
+      description: What happened, and what did you expect instead?
+    validations:
+      required: true
+  - type: textarea
+    id: reproduction
+    attributes:
+      label: Minimal reproduction
+      description: Include the smallest code sample, config, or command that reproduces the problem.
+    validations:
+      required: true
+  - type: textarea
+    id: environment
+    attributes:
+      label: Environment
+      description: Include Vocos, Python, PyTorch, TorchAudio, operating system, and accelerator versions.
+      placeholder: |
+        Vocos:
+        Python:
+        PyTorch / TorchAudio:
+        OS:
+        CPU / GPU:
+    validations:
+      required: true
+  - type: input
+    id: checkpoint
+    attributes:
+      label: Checkpoint or config
+      description: Name the checkpoint and revision, or the config file, if relevant.
+  - type: textarea
+    id: audio
+    attributes:
+      label: Audio details
+      description: Include input shape, channels, sample rate, and preprocessing if the problem affects audio output.
+  - type: textarea
+    id: logs
+    attributes:
+      label: Logs or traceback
+      render: shell
+  - type: checkboxes
+    id: checks
+    attributes:
+      label: Checklist
+      options:
+        - label: I searched the existing issues and pull requests.
+          required: true
+        - label: I removed private data and credentials from the reproduction and logs.
+          required: true

+name: Feature request
+description: Propose a focused, backward-compatible improvement
+title: "[Feature]: "
+labels: [enhancement]
+body:
+  - type: textarea
+    id: use-case
+    attributes:
+      label: Use case
+      description: What problem would this solve, and who would benefit?
+    validations:
+      required: true
+  - type: textarea
+    id: proposal
+    attributes:
+      label: Proposed change
+      description: Describe the smallest useful change and any alternatives you considered.
+    validations:
+      required: true
+  - type: textarea
+    id: compatibility
+    attributes:
+      label: Compatibility considerations
+      description: Note any effects on checkpoints, tensor shapes, sample rates, training configs, or public APIs.
+  - type: checkboxes
+    id: checks
+    attributes:
+      label: Checklist
+      options:
+        - label: I searched the existing issues and pull requests.
+          required: true

+## Summary
+
+Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.
+
+## Validation
+
+List the checks you ran and any relevant Python, PyTorch, and TorchAudio versions. If a check was not run, explain why.
+
+## Compatibility
+
+- [ ] Published checkpoints and checkpoint keys are unchanged.
+- [ ] Public tensor shapes, sample rates, and defaults are unchanged, or the change is documented above.
+- [ ] No model files or generated binaries are included.
+
+## Related issues
+
+Link any related issue, for example `Fixes #123`.

+The training entry point, configs, and metrics live in the source repository. To train a model, clone the repository
+and install it with the training dependencies:
 
 ```bash
-pip install vocos[train]
+git clone https://github.com/gemelo-ai/vocos.git
+cd vocos

+python -m pip install -e ".[train]"
 ```

+The checked-in training stack pins PyTorch Lightning 1.8.6, which still uses `pkg_resources`; keeping Setuptools below
+version 80 in the training environment preserves that compatibility.
